text:
sasha: CI alert: audit-contract-checker job failing on main with golden diff for customer 'acme-corp'. It flags missing actor.email in emitted audit events. job: https://ci.internal/redwood/jobs/audit-contract-checker/321
jenna: I saw that too. Only happens for events where RBAC masks subject (demo accounts). Quick scan: failing diff shows email=null instead of omitted key :thinking:
kevin: suspect redaction hook order changed in infra PR #4321 — redaction may be running before validator now. If validator expects absent vs null mismatch causes golden diff.
omar: also note we rotated KMS last week. KMS envelope wrapper now emits "redacted":true in metadata; could be linked. cc @jenna
jenna: repro locally:
```
{"event_type":"user.login","actor":{"id":"U-123","email":null},"meta":{"redacted":true}}
```
validator schema expects `actor.email` to be optional (absent) not null:
```
"actor": { "type":"object", "properties": { "id":{"type":"string"}, "email":{"type":"string"} }, "required":["id"] }
```
sasha: short-term mitigation: relax contract checker to accept null for actor.email or special-case metadata.redacted === true. We should avoid changing production emitters yet.
kevin: agree. can flip CI to compare using normalizer script instead of strict JSON diff. run:
`./scripts/ci-run.sh audit-contract-checker --normalize redacted-emails`
audit-bot: Re-run scheduled: audit-contract-checker #322 triggered by @kevin (preserve logs at https://ci.internal/redwood/jobs/322)
sasha: assigning to kevin + jenna to open quick PR to normalize null->absent and add unit test. we'll follow-up with a postmortem if golden fixture drift is customer-impacting. :white_check_mark:
omar: heads-up — we should scan dedicated/private customer logs for any events with null emails in last 48h. If customer-visible, prepare customer note draft.
jenna: I'll update golden fixtures in repo under testdata/goldens and add a test that simulates KMS redaction metadata.
sasha: plan: (1) hotfix CI normalizer (2) run scan (3) update goldens + tests (4) revert if we fix emitter order. tagging security-audit. i'll update incident board.
